source: ROM trn_174h (Tron LE 1.74): font table RAM 0x36f48 -> 0x04000000+0x125778, count RAM 0x36f44 = 44

placement.glyph_blit: x_draw = pen_x + x_offset; y_draw = y - h + y_offset + 1 (y = baseline row passed to the draw call)

flags.1: fit only: allow x + width <= 128 (font lists, max_width 0)

placement.text_width: max(pen positions after each glyph, before spacing) - min(pen positions) -- code 0x28a74
placement.masked: true: pixel 255 in the glyph image is transparent (bitmap_blit_masked 0x2b2a0), else opaque blit 0x2b194
placement.image: index into the ROM image table (RAM 0x36f50); = file name NNNN.png in mpf_package/media/rom_images_all.zip
